$description: Closed motion-pattern vocabulary. pinsScroll=true patterns count toward the SCROLL_PIN_BUDGET rule. Reduced-motion fallbacks are a design-repo requirement: the clone source has no prefers-reduced-motion handling.

text-reveal.description: SplitText lines y 100%->0, stagger .25, .5s power1.out, start 'top 75%', once.

pill-wipe-loop.description: Pill logo clip-path wipe in, hold 3s, wipe out; infinite.

path-travel-loop.description: DrawSVG dashes travel along .animate paths while in view (linear, infinite).

footer-lines-pointer.description: PIXI lines bend around a cursor-following pill (elastic.out(1.5,.3) 3s on hover devices).

word-rotator.description: AutoAnimate word swap every 3000ms, yPercent +-100, 1s power3.inOut.

pointer-parallax.description: Mouse parallax on illustration groups (1s power3.out); virtual pointer on non-hover devices.

marquee-loop.description: Constant linear marquee (focus pill; about photo marquee ramps timeScale 0->1 with scrub 4).

dock-pin.description: Request Demo button pinned and docked top-right for ~8 viewport heights.

step-pin-sequence.description: How-It-Works text/image parts soft-pinned per step; images fade over +-25vh.

evidence.anchor: gsap.from(part, { opacity: 0, scrollTrigger: { trigger: part, start: () => st.start - KP(25), end: () => st.start, scrub: true } })

illustration-intro.description: Illustration layers from {opacity 0, y 400} 2s power3.out at 'center 75%', then float.

evidence.anchor: gsap.fromTo(el, { yPercent: -A }, { yPercent: A, yoyo: true, ease: 'power2.inOut', repeat: -1, duration: D, delay: i * D * 0.3 })

hover-reveal.description: Hover-only reveal (badge gray layer opacity .5s; logo ovals + colour .5s).

autoanimate-swap.description: AutoAnimate content swap with size morph, 1s power3.inOut.

intro-timeline.description: /solutions/ hero intro played after the preloader/transition 'anyEnd'.

evidence.anchor: tl.fromTo(ills, from, { ...to, ease: 'power2.out', stagger: { from: 'random', each: 0.025 }, onComplete: startBob }, 0)

stacked-pin-slide-up.description: Section pinned at bottom-bottom while the next rounded panel slides over; children drift -40vh linear.

evidence.anchor: ScrollTrigger.create({ trigger: section, pin: true, start: 'bottom bottom', end: 'bottom top', pinSpacing: false })

hover-bounce.description: Explore cart box bounce on mouseenter (bounce.out .8s).

card-stack-pin.description: 4 cards pinned at centre; earlier cards scale 1-.1(n-i), yPercent -11(n-i).

evidence.anchor: scrollTrigger: { trigger: card, start: 'center center', endTrigger: last, end: 'center center', scrub: true },

horizontal-snap-scrub.description: Touch mobile: horizontal snap carousel with per-card scale/x scrub + nudge hint.

laptop-lid-scrub.description: Laptop lid from rotateX(-80) open on scroll, scrub 3.

hero-entrance.description: About hero: wrapper scale .5->1, box y 200lvh->0, lines yPercent 100 stagger .2.

line-fill-scrub.description: Per-line gradient text fill scrubbed with scroll (.8/N stagger, linear).

hero-pin.description: About hero pinned 0->135vh (yPercent -50, scrub .1) while Founded slides over.

stagger-entrance.description: Leadership cards from yPercent 40 / opacity 0, stagger .1, at 'top 75%'.

pulse-draw-loop.description: Careers large pulse drawSVG 0->100%, hold, erase; infinite.

sticky-pin.description: CSS position: sticky equivalent of the original ScrollTrigger pin (blog sidebar top 40u, share column top 120u).

reducedMotionFallbacks.static-visible: Render every element in its final, visible state; no reveal, fade or loop.
reducedMotionFallbacks.static-final-frame: Render the end state of scroll-driven sequences (e.g. dashboard at natural size, counters at final value); no pin, no zoom.
reducedMotionFallbacks.static-inline: Keep pinned/docking elements in their inline position.
reducedMotionFallbacks.static-stacked: Render pinned/stacked parts as an ordinary vertical stack, fully visible.
reducedMotionFallbacks.static-paused: Show the first frame of loops (marquees, floats) without movement.
reducedMotionFallbacks.static-filled: Render line-fill text fully filled (final colour).
reducedMotionFallbacks.static-open: Render the laptop lid open; carousel swaps are instant.
reducedMotionFallbacks.instant-swap: Swap carousel/form states instantly without tweening.
reducedMotionFallbacks.static-lines: Footer lines drawn straight; no pointer-driven bending.
reducedMotionFallbacks.sticky-unchanged: Keep CSS sticky positioning (not an animation); disable image fades.
